task: Register existing Vercel runtime target preflight with Release Domain authority so protected Fresh Office preview scope resolves canonically

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This is an authority-map repair for a security-critical environment preflight. It makes the existing runtime guard explicitly owned by DOMAIN-RELEASE. Source tests and exact-head CI prove deterministic mapping but cannot prove hosted authenticated acceptance.

acceptanceCriteria: The canonical DOMAIN-RELEASE registry explicitly includes scripts/validate-vercel-deploy-env.mjs without any wildcard covering unintended files.
The release-domain single owner release-infrastructure is unchanged and no domain overlaps are introduced.
The architecture-health test verifies this exact path and owner.
No changes to validator execution or Vercel/Supabase environment are made.
invariants: Domain authority remains unique for the environment preflight.
Quality controls and release domain truth remain distinct.
Staging and production runtime targets remain hard-coded and fail-closed in the unmodified validator.
A later implementation has to go through the Plan Before Code gate based on this exact domain registration.
forbiddenStates: Register the validator with an unrelated business domain.
Change the validator behavior as part of this authority-only unit.
Treat the registry change as deployed Fresh Install UI acceptance.

failureModes: The preflight script remains architecture-unresolved and future controlled changes are blocked.
An overbroad registry wildcard changes ownership of unrelated quality guards.
Two domains claim equal-specificity ownership of the validator.
The architecture-health regression accidentally relies on a duplicate script constant.
An authority-only change is mistaken for release authorization.
edgeCases: Validator source path matches release domain exactly.
Quality generator scripts continue to belong to DOMAIN-QUALITY.
A test for release domain adds no runtime Vercel mutation.
Plan Before Code can resolve the preflight path in a later child transaction.
The registry change affects only domain metadata and testing, not secret runtime.

alternatives.summary: Add exact Vercel preflight path to canonical Release Domain source ownership.
alternatives.reason: The validator protects deployment target, schema compatibility and release authorization, properly owned by Release.

alternatives.summary: Assign all scripts to Quality Domain.
alternatives.reason: Would overclaim architecture scope and obscure release truth ownership for unrelated scripts.

alternatives.summary: Proceed with the Vercel exception while architecture remains unresolved.
alternatives.reason: Violates Plan Before Code and makes a cross-environment security change unreviewable.

specialistReviews.finding: Runtime Vercel preflight missing from domain registry means release authority is unresolved.
specialistReviews.resolution: Bind it by exact path to DOMAIN-RELEASE and assert classification in architecture-health test.

specialistReviews.finding: A wildcard release mapping could hide unrelated quality and auth-critical source ownership.
specialistReviews.resolution: Change only exact path; explicitly reject scripts/** wildcard.

specialistReviews.finding: Changing domain metadata is not permission to deploy against Fresh or reactivate staging.
specialistReviews.resolution: Treat this as preflight prerequisite and preserve existing main-only Vercel build skip.

specialistReviews.finding: A new domain owner could expand Known Failure applicability and break downstream code-review coverage.
specialistReviews.resolution: Run full Codebase Atlas, quality and CI after the small registry change.

challenge.scenario: A PR changes runtime schema preflight.
challenge.finding: Atlas previously reports no domain authority.
challenge.resolution: Register exact path in Release Domain.

challenge.scenario: A quality guard script is evaluated.
challenge.finding: A broad wildcard could transfer it to Release.
challenge.resolution: Preserve original quality canonical path rules.

challenge.finding: Multiple owners conflict with single-truth domain mapping.
challenge.resolution: Use exact path only and assert release owner.

challenge.scenario: The Vercel environment still points at inactive staging for generic preview.
challenge.finding: Mapping alone might be misunderstood as a Fresh deployment fix.
challenge.resolution: Do not modify Vercel environment or publish a preview.

challenge.scenario: A future exception is built without runtime schema probes.
challenge.finding: Architecture registration might be treated as approval to bypass runtime checks.
challenge.resolution: Keep unmodified script and separate later explicit guard transaction.

challenge.scenario: CI evaluates other release-infrastructure source files.
challenge.finding: Authority registration could unintentionally change their domain.
challenge.resolution: Assert exact file mapping and no new wildcard.

challenge.scenario: An Alap user enters the Pro Office route.
challenge.finding: Domain mapping cannot grant subscriptions or user rights.
challenge.resolution: Do not modify application permission/plan code.

challenge.scenario: A future Vercel build has an invalid server secret.
challenge.finding: This authority repair cannot substitute for credential validation.
challenge.resolution: Retain original fail-closed preflight runtime code.

proofPlan: Run Plan Before Code for exact quality registry and architecture test paths.
Test single release-domain registration and registry integrity without editing deployment validator.
Full CI quality, typecheck, build, architecture-health, Truth and Lifecycle exact-head proof.
Only after this unit, create a separate child for the scoped Fresh acceptance branch exception.
operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Shoperation Plan Before Code correctly found the existing Vercel schema-compatibility preflight script has no explicit architecture domain, although it controls staging/production target and server credentials. Before any Fresh-only preview policy change, its release-domain ownership must be canonical and testable.
observableOutcomes: scripts/validate-vercel-deploy-env.mjs has the canonical DOMAIN-RELEASE authority in domain-foundations without changing preflight functionality.
No unrelated domain owner or quality authority is reclassified and the architecture-health test proves exact file mapping.
A later, separately planned preview guard change can resolve its release authority without overriding Plan Before Code architecture errors.
unresolvedRisks: The Fresh-only preview capability is not added by this unit; the original hard-coded staging preview gate remains.
The Vercel preview environment has owner-set sensitive Fresh secret but its correctness remains runtime-unverified.
This metadata change does not prove end-user draft save or owner denied access.

in: Add one exact existing Vercel preflight source file path under the Release Domain canonicalPaths registry.
Add an architecture-health regression that verifies one explicit owner and prevents domain drift.
out: Do not modify the validator source file or its strict production/staging target rules.
Do not create or run deployments, change migrations, OAuth providers, preview secrets, tenant data or global Vercel build settings.

requirements.requirement: Register the Vercel environment schema preflight exact source path under the Release Domain so future security changes receive a determinate single authority.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No broad architecture remapping, Vercel deployment exception, or hosted secret mutation may be introduced.

notes: Precondition architecture correction before any change to validator itself. The protected Vercel deployment preflight currently has no release domain ownership in the canonical Atlas. This unit only maps its existing source path under DOMAIN-RELEASE and proves single-source ownership; no deploy or validator runtime code change. It is deliberately separate from the subsequent Fresh Install preview conditional policy.
